To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a new data set is proposed for AVSD, 2) a new end to end AVSD model that combines the state of the art in dialog, VQA, and video description is introduced, and 3) the proposed AVSD model outperforms the state of the arts in AVSD.
we introduce a new dataset of dialogs about videos, and an end to end AVSD model, trained on this dataset, that generates responses to questions about videos.
we developed a new AVSD data set and an AVSD system that uses multimodal attention based visual features for video description to generate dialogs about dynamic video scenes.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we propose an end to end AVSD system that can generate responses about a given video, and we introduce a new dataset to support this system.
the proposed system is able to generate dialog about dynamic video scene by combining state of the art technology in multiple research areas.
we present a new data set and model for AVSD, and demonstrate the effectiveness of multimodal attention based features for AVSD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new data set and an end to end model for AVSD.
we propose an AVSD system, trained end to end, which can generate dialog in real time about a dynamic audio visual scene.
we have created a new AVSD task and a new AVSD data set for this task, as well as a new AVSD model for the task that is trained using the data set.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of state of the art video description technologies with end to end dialog systems can improve the quality of dialogs about dynamic audiovisual scenes.
a multimodal attention based end to end AVSD system can generate responses in a dialog that are relevant to the video and the dialog history.
the combination of end to end dialog and multimodal attention based visual features is a good starting point for building AVSD systems.
